# CLAUDE.md — `crates/otio-schema`

> Dev conventions (Alex Joss, joss13@gmail.com): see `../../CONVENTIONS.md`.

## What
Typed, schema-aware layer over `otio-core` (Phase 2 of otio-rs, see `../../PLAN.md`).
Three parts:
- `edit.rs` — typed setters over `(&mut Document, NodeId)`: `set_source_range`,
  `set_enabled`, `set_name`, `set_color`, `set_track_kind`, `set_metadata`.
  Optional fields clear to JSON `null` (OTIO `optional<T>` writers emit null,
  verified in serialization.cpp:953/962/987 — never omit). Get an id from any
  view's `id()`.
- `codec.rs` — OTIO value-type schemas <-> `otio-time` types + JSON
  (`RationalTime`/`TimeRange`/`TimeTransform`/`Color`). Decoders return `Option`
  (no panics); encoders emit integral numbers as integers (`"rate": 24`).
- `view.rs` — borrow-only views (`Timeline`, `Stack`, `Track`, `Clip`, `Gap`,
  `Transition`, `Marker`, `Effect`, `MediaRef`, `AnyItem`). Each wraps
  `(&Document, &Node)` and decodes fields lazily.

Lib root `src/otio_schema.rs` (`[lib] name = "otio_schema"`).

## Design
- **No parallel data copy.** Views read the verbatim fields otio-core stores, so
  they cannot drift from what serializes. (Single source of truth.)
- Shared `Item`/`Composition` behavior via `NodeView` / `ItemView` traits with
  default methods; concrete views are generated by the `view_struct!` macro
  (except `Effect`/`MediaRef`, which span multiple schema names → hand-written).
- `AnyItem` resolves a heterogeneous track/stack child to its typed variant.
- `MediaRef` holds only `&Node` (it's a leaf — no children to follow).

## Status
- [x] Codec + read views for the editorial schemas. `cargo test -p otio-schema`
      → 5 pass (codec round-trips + Color/name + `navigate_simple_cut` +
      `clip2_media_reference_via_map` over the real corpus).
- [x] Typed setters (`edit.rs`): 7 tests total, incl. mutate -> serialize -> parse
      persistence and clear-source_range -> JSON null.
- [x] Workspace green, clippy clean.
- [x] All views expose `id()` (via `NodeView`) so callers can mutate.
- [x] **Verified by 3 independent agents** vs the C++ reference (field-name parity,
      schema classification, codec JSON shape). All findings reviewed against the
      reference directly and applied:
  - **Color** carries the mandatory `name` field (decode + `color_value` encode);
    OTIO's deserializer requires it.
  - **Clip.2** `media_reference()` resolves via `media_references` map +
    `active_media_reference_key` (was returning `None` on Clip.2 data).
  - **Track::kind()** now returns `Option<&str>` (no fabricated `"Video"` default
    masking malformed input).
  - Added ImageSequenceReference fields (`name_prefix`/`name_suffix`/`frame_step`/
    `frame_zero_padding`/`rate`).

## Gotchas
- `Marker` exposes its fields via the `NodeViewMarkerExt` trait (kept separate so
  the `view_struct!` macro stays generic). Import the trait to use them.
- Decoders are permissive (`Option`): a malformed value yields `None`, not an
  error — callers decide. This matches lazy-view ergonomics, not a silent
  data-loss fallback (the verbatim field is still preserved by otio-core).
